name: Hikari's Ribbon
source:
Embark on a journey to regain a dear, lost friend. A short, heartwarming tale of friendship and trust. 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250401005317/https://renai.us/game/hikariRibbon]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
踏上旅途，找回一位珍贵却失散的朋友。这是一段关于友情与信任的温暖短篇故事。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250401005317/https://renai.us/game/hikariRibbon]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
